#   http://sweet.ua.pt/tos/twin_gaps.html
#
# Count limit --- 1e16
#   g  is the gap between twin prime pairs
# F(g) is the least prime of the first twin prime
#      pair of the first occurrence of a gap of g
# T(g) is the number of times a gap of g occurs
#      with the last prime of the second prime pair
#      of a gap smaller than 1e16
# An * marks a record-holder; g is a record-holder
#      if F(u) > F(g) for all u > g; F(g) is a
#      record-holder if F(u) < F(g) for all u < g
#
# Last update made on August 5, 2013
